notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Will.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Will.
Repeat from step 4.
